title: NSGo game sprite animation state machine (version 1)
description: StateMachineDoc is the plain-text YAML schema of a *.states.yaml sprite animation state machine.

version.description: Version is the schema version; it must equal StateMachineVersion (1).

uid.description: UID is an optional stable file ID assigned by game index or the editor for safe renames.

name.description: Name is an optional human-readable display name for the state machine.

entry.description: Entry is the name of the state the machine enters when playback starts or resets.

parameters.description: Parameters are the named inputs that transition conditions read.

states.description: States are the named animation states, each playing one animation clip.

transitions.description: Transitions are the directed edges evaluated in declaration order on every fixed Update step.

ParamDoc.description: ParamDoc declares one named parameter of a StateMachineDoc.

name.description: Name is the parameter identifier used in transition expressions, such as "move.x", "velocity.y", "on_floor" or "jump".

type.description: Type is the parameter kind: "float", "bool" or "trigger".

default.description: Default is the optional starting value: a number for "float", a boolean for "bool", and omitted for "trigger".

StateDoc.description: StateDoc declares one state of a StateMachineDoc.

name.description: Name is the unique state name within the state machine, such as "idle" or "run".

clip.description: Clip is the project-relative path or resolver key of the animation clip resource played while this state is active.

speed.description: Speed is an optional playback speed multiplier (> 0); 0 or omitted plays at 1x speed.

loop.description: Loop optionally overrides the clip's own loop setting while played in this state.

x.description: X is an optional horizontal coordinate of this state node in the editor graph.

y.description: Y is an optional vertical coordinate of this state node in the editor graph.

TransitionDoc.description: TransitionDoc declares one directed transition from From (or "*" for any state) to To.

from.description: From is the source state name, or "*" (AnyState) to match any state other than To.

to.description: To is the target state name; it must name a state in States.

label.description: Label is an optional human-readable summary shown on the editor graph edge and LEAVING list.

when.description: When is an optional boolean expression over declared parameters, such as "|move.x| > 0.1" or "jump && on_floor".

onEnd.description: OnEnd fires this transition when the source state's clip finishes playing (and When, if set, is also true).
